title: Man at Attic Desk
description: An elderly man with white hair sits in a burgundy leather chair at a large wooden desk in a sunlit attic room. He faces a black computer monitor with his back partially to the viewer, surrounded by scattered papers, a mug, telephone, and printer, while a floral still-life painting hangs on the warm yellow wall behind him.
